quest.title: Riddles Awaiting Answers
quest.description: In a wondrous room, Caterpillar recalls something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: The familiar setting is stirring my memory... Yes, this is the Narzissenkreuz Ordo.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean this is the Narzissenkreuz Ordo we're looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Well, there are no longer any ceremonial items here, nor has there been a Dispelling Ritual conducted for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: However, this is undoubtedly where the sinners of Fontaine once congregated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And just what's a Dispelling Ritual? Well, not that that's super important.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you spot any clues? You know, the kind that outsiders like us would easily miss.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, this is the Narzissenkreuz Ordo!

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Hmm. There are no longer any ceremonial items here, nor has there been a Dispelling Ritual conducted for a long time. Nonetheless...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Yes, the familiar setting is stirring my memory. This is the right place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe there might be clues that we've overlooked, but that you could spot off the bat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, have you found anything?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: All I see are memories of a past and things that were that shall never again catch up to me. Does that count?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Paimon doesn't wanna interrupt your reminiscing, but that doesn't sound like what we're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Perhaps, but my past is inextricably intertwined with the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, the chief culprit of the great sin.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: As such, some of my memories may yet be helpful to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, could you start telling us about them, Caterpillar?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I should warn you that I was not in the inner circle several hundred years ago, so I don't know everything about the incident.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: But I was personally mentored by Narzissenkreuz, who should be the origin of all this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Narzissenkreuz...? Isn't that...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: "There's a prophet lying dormant in all of us, and when he wakes, one more evil shall walk the world"...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: That's the sort of person he is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, since we've got this opportunity, is there anything else you want to ask, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: If I find anything worth mentioning, I'll let you know immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Or if I'm not around, I'll leave a note behind, you know, like one of those forgetful adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, okay then... You take care.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: You too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll wait for you.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Caterpillar leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you have any other questions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself, Caterpillar...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: About me? I thought we got acquainted well enough during our jailbreak.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: But I understand that you're asking about something deeper.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: "Now, I shall perform a terrible feat that never been done before and will never be done again..."

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: "...I will expose someone's true self before all, without any facade or masks... and that someone shall be myself."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's really... a lot. Paimon doesn't think she can lighten this atmosphere up at all...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Lanoire has already gone home, did she not? We have to face a more complicated world now.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: The time for things from under the age of nine is over. Next, we probably need the experiences from age sixteen or so—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... What? Uh, the "experiences from sixteen or so"?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: The first voice I heard while in this body was that of Narzissenkreuz.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Other than speaking of the redeeming powers of the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz, he also preached thus:

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: "The body is just a shell. Even the body of a hilichurl can bear sentient consciousness."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did he create you, then?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Perhaps he did. I've tried to unravel my own origin, but the answers I got were all pretty vague.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Poor you...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Well, I don't really feel that way.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I have discovered, after all, that most humans do not know the reason why they were born, and yet they still live happily.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Also, it is not quite correct to say that he "created me."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How so?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Creation is a feat for a god... If we may call the one above a "god."

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: In the tenets of Narzissenkreuz, do you know what is most critical in creating someone?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: It's imagination. Imagining a person, down to the last detail, akin to an Oceanid imagining a creature in the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: There's a story that tells of a powerful mage-priest imagining his own son, only to realize he himself was the product of someone else's imagination.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Sorry for digressing, but I feel that this information is relevant to your questions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that didn't make anything clear, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Narzissenkreuz Ordo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since you find this place so familiar, what could you tell us about it?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Actually, as I recall, most of the people in the Narzissenkreuz Ordo were very kind.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Narzissenkreuz's teachings just contained many radical ideas that were, perhaps, difficult for people to accept.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound good at all...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Narzissenkreuz would lead ceremonies with the Holy Blade, in accordance with the ancient dictates.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: They call it "Tri-Factor Excision" in Liyue, and in Sumeru, "Shattering Atmagraha." He called it "Renunciation of the Ego."

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: He believed that one's own will is an obstacle, and that accidentally receiving a Vision while seeking the path is a guaranteed path to destruction.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... After someone gives themselves up, what happens to them?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Well, they stay quite normal, actually. It is said that people cannot perceive the truth, because a body with a self sees the world filtered through the five senses.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound so scary, then.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: However, I never found out what Narzissenkreuz's ultimate purpose for collecting all those wills and selves was.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you elaborate concerning Narissenkreuz?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Another time, perhaps. There is so much to be said... I'll need time to process it all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About what happened all those years ago...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Many years ago, the one then called "Lord-Artificer" Guillotin and Narzissenkreuz had an intense clash.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Guillotin was even called the "White Cavalier of Protection" back then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pffft.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that a better title than Honorary Knight?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Well, if we're comparing impressive titles, I submit "Chrysalis of the Phantasmic Moth."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bwahahaha, just what kind of weird title is that!?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: ...The title that the Ordo gave me. See, I'm Caterpillar, a creature that turns into a chrysalis before completely metamorphosing into a butterfly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—Sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I suppose the name contained the wings of hope that I would mature into a human.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even though we learned a lot...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's still more questions that will need answers...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I'll have to pore over the records and try to piece it all together.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: So, I'm afraid you won't always find me here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fontaine can be dangerous for you as it is now...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I'll disguise myself, and rely on the methods I've developed to do what I must. I'll survive.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: *Yawn*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Ann, you're awake!

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: #Oh... Good morning, Paimon, Knight {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, allow Paimon to introduce you two. This is our Oceanid friend, Ann. Ann, this is...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: My name is Caterpillar. A pleasure to meet you, Ann.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Likewise, Caterpillar... Huh. Have we met?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: My memory is fading, so that is quite possible. If I may be so blunt, what is your relationship with the Red Empress?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: The Red Empress? I have no idea who that is, though the name kind of rings a bell.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Then let me try another name... What is your relationship with Lyris?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: How do you know that name?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: #I went through many adventures with Paimon and {NICKNAME} just to find out that she was merely a character in a story.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, what's going on? Do you know Lyris, Caterpillar?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Do I? Hmm. Ah. I think I know what's going on.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I'm also a victim of riddles, so I shan't play dumb — I'll tell you everything I know.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Lyris did indeed exist. She was an Oceanid as well, and Narzissenkreuz's name for her within the Ordo was the "Red Empress."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait? What? So what happened to her?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I don't know, though I do have a hunch.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Can you tell me?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I fear this hunch isn't worth bringing up. Besides, I suspect that you've already figured it out, being as smart as you are. Am I wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Figured what out?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: The first thing you said to me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "My name is Caterpillar..."

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: No, the next line!

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: What my relation to the Red Empress — or Lyris the Oceanid, is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, you should visit Mary-Ann in the Annapausis, Caterpillar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe that will confirm your hunch.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: A reasonable suggestion.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: #I won't be troubling you this time, Knight {NICKNAME}, Paimon. I'll go with Caterpillar.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you sure?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Trust me.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: And me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, then... We'll see you back here later.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Negative. Danger. Danger. Activity by Narzissenkreuz Ordo remnants detected.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Disk Defragmentation Emergency Interruption.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, please find a safe place immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Seymour, calm down! This is...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: We meet again. What did the White Cavalier of Protection say about you? Ah, yes. "This is my little invention."

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative. I am... *garbled mechnical noises* prototype, with a large number of bold design elements.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: ...The priority level of this topic has been downgraded. Please lay down your arms and surrender.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: #Seymour, listen to me. I've already surrendered to {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Is that so?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, totally.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Very well. In that case, we can continue to discuss my extraordinary design.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I am Caterpillar, as you know. Speaking of which, how's the young lady you were protecting doing?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: ...Wait a moment. Why did I say something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: You are correct. I am looking for the master I should protect, Ma—

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Mary-Ann. Or, as you might call her, Mary-Ann Guillotin.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Mary-Ann Guillotin!

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: ... *mechanical noises* ...*the mechnical noises slowly become clearer* Guillotin.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Correct. My designer. Guillotin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Caterpillar, is this your memories from hundreds of years ago, y'know, getting clearer?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: No. This is a memory from before my birth, something akin to an elephant recalling its previous life while meditating.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: I do not understand. Previous lives do not exist.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Not for you, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, it seems that I've encountered a potential breakthrough I had never imagined possible. Perhaps I might find the secrets to my own birth after all.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Though I do not understand, I am glad to have been of service.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, why don't we exchange information?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since Seymour's here, maybe you'll be able to find some special records or something, Caterpillar.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: I do not understand, but I determine the likelihood of success to be: high.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You share information...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: So, Jakob has emerged...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I have another hypothesis about all this, but to prove my conjecture, I still need to conduct some onsite investigations. If you could accompany us, Seymour, that would help a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: This is a decision that will help restore my records. I will accompany you.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: #Very good. In that case... {NICKNAME}, Paimon, once I am 90% confident, I will inform you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ann and Seymour return to the Narzissenkreuz Ordo...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Negative. Danger. Danger. Activity by Narzissenkreuz Ordo remnants detected.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Ann, please find a safe place immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Annihilation mode activated.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: I didn't know you could do that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Seymour, calm down! This is...

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Anyway, h—hello, Caterpillar... Have we met?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: My memory is fading, so that is quite possible. If I may be so blunt, what is your relationship with the Red Empress?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: The Red Empress? I have no idea who that is, though the name kind of rings a bell.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Then let me try another name... What is your relationship with Lyris?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: How do you know that name?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: #I went through many adventures with Paimon and {NICKNAME} just to find out that she was merely a character in a story.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Do I? Hmm. Ah. I think I know what's going on.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I'm also a victim of riddles, so I shan't play dumb — I'll tell you everything I know.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Lyris did indeed exist. She was an Oceanid as well, and Narzissenkreuz's name for her within the Ordo was the "Red Empress."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon feels like it's all connected!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, when we first got here, Paimon couldn't help but notice... The clock here doesn't seem very accurate, does it?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Ah. That.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Simply put, it's the Doomsday Clock.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Doomsday Clock?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: When the clock strikes midnight, the apocalypse will come.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Doesn't this mean that the end of the world is almost upon us?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Huh, that really does take me back. When I was here before, they thought the apocalypse was still far away, and that though it wouldn't happen in our generation, we should stop it for the sake of the future.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: If the clock is accurate, then it is not far off now. Perhaps we shall lay ourselves down to sleep tonight, and the sun shall not rise in the morn. Perhaps the sea shall evaporate tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Or perhaps we are already living in the apocalypse, and the good times have long ended.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Get serious! Will the apocalypse really come?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: First, what we see is just a "clock," not the apocalypse itself. When it comes down to it, time is merely a tool humans use to measure changes in all forms of matter.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Narzissenkreuz was the one who used the "world-formula" to calculate the beginning of the end, and built this device.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: As such, I cannot answer your question, dear Paimon. Because this is all it is — a clock.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's share our findings...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon briefly share all that happened with the other three people (though technically speaking, none of them are humans).

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Input logged.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Elynas...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you think of something?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: I don't know. I'm not sure. It's like water boiling off into gas. I can't see it, and I can't quite grasp it, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh. Any thoughts or leads, Caterpillar?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Hmm... Can't say that I don't, but I'm still trying to sort some things out, so let's discuss this later.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Right. I kept forgetting to ask you something.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, I'm very grateful for everything you've done for Lanoire. So, is there anything that I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Do you mean... anything? Just like making a wish?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Haha! It should be something within the scope of my abilities, of course. You did free Lanoire and I from prison, but I'm no Jinn in a bottle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what would your wish be, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, if that's the case, then Mora... No, wait, yummy food...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aah! There's so much that Paimon wants, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been having lots of fun traveling together, so we don't really need anything special. Instead, Caterpillar, can you help us help Ann and Seymour?

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, what do you think? Is that a good wish?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: I understand. Then, let us work together.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: #Now, I plan to work with Seymour and Ann to see if we can use our experiences and the information available here to figure something new out. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, let's meet back here later.
